jobs.title: District Sales Manager 1
jobs.description:
Job Details

Division: Nucor Rebar Fabrication South Central

Location: Waxahachie, TX, United States

Other Available Locations: Oklahoma

Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.

Nucor supports its teammates with top-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay-for-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.

Basic Job Functions:

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

Purpose:
The primary role of the District Sales Manager is to lead the sales and marketing efforts for the Nucor Rebar Fabrication Oklahoma market territory in support of taking care of our customers. The District Sales Manager will be responsible for quoting and securing business, providing forecasts, and recommending new business and customers. Supporting Rebar Fabrication’s strategic growth initiatives, as well as Nucor’s Commercial Excellence initiatives are essential. The DSM will also be expected to participate in and promote an atmosphere of cooperation and teamwork.

This position will require extensive travel and face to face interaction with our customers, therefore the candidate must have the ability to drive and travel in their region/market, as required. Hired candidate will report to branches in the Southcentral region for training and meeting, as needed.

Responsibilities:
•    Provide industry leading service.
•    Serve as the forward-facing representative of Nucor Rebar Fabrication, to win work and understand the customer’s business.
•    Prospect for new business.
•    Build relationships and rapport with customers.
•    Work interactively with Inside Sales and Estimating to effectively complete tasks.
•    Operate as a liaison between customers and Nucor Rebar Fabrication Operations.
•    Establish annual sales plans for the assigned region/market, by working with the Regional Sales Manager and Sales Manager.
•    Proactively and positively problem-solve to help the team achieve and exceed revenue, shipment, and profitability goals.
•    Utilize strong organizational skills, with proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage time, in an unsupervised environment.
•    Collaborate with other sales departments, regions, and sales support to support business objectives.
•    Proactively drive change within the organization. Understand and promote that change is constant and we will continually strive to improve our workplace processes and effectiveness.

Minimum Qualifications:

•    Legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship now or in the future.
•    At least 5 years Sales or Marketing experience in the steel industry.
•    Willingness to travel extensively.

Preferred Qualifications:

•    Demonstrated commitment to safety, quality, development, and profitability.
•    Experience in customer relations and resolving problems or disputes.
•    A basic knowledge of contracts, standard business practices and human relations.

Special Demands:
•    Work schedule may include hours beyond the normal business day.
•    This position will require extensive travel and face to face interaction with our customers, therefore the candidate must have the ability to drive and travel in their region/market, as required.
•    Must maintain strict confidentiality regarding certain customer and management information.

Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace

jobs.title: Sales and Business Development Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
Job Details

Division: Nucor Corporation

Location: Salt Lake City, Kansas City, Louisville

Other Available Locations: Kansas; Kentucky; Ohio

Compensation: $27.00/hr + relocation assistance if applicable

About Nucor

Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every teammate with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.

WATCH THIS VIDEO and WATCH THIS OTHER VIDEO to get a sense of what we do, who we are, our opportunities and our work environment.

What You'll Do:

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

The Sales and Business Development Internship is a hands-on summer internship designed to introduce students to the commercial side of the scrap metal recycling business. Interns learn how customer and supplier relationships are developed, how market conditions influence business decisions, and how commercial teammates support profitable business growth across the recycling group.

Work alongside commercial teammates and leaders to build foundational knowledge of scrap buying, material grades, market trends, pricing, customer service, logistics, and daily facility operations. Through field exposure, mentorship, and a summer-long business project, interns gain a practical understanding of what a commercial career in scrap metal recycling could look like after graduation.

Duties of the role include, but are not limited to:

- Participate in daily safety meetings and uphold safety, housekeeping, and operational standards.

- Shadow commercial teammates during supplier, customer, and vendor interactions.

- Assist with market research, prospect identification, customer follow-up, and sales preparation.

- Learn how market conditions, material grades, pricing, transportation, and logistics influence business decisions.

- Develop an understanding of the scrap recycling market through facility exposure, customer visits, and mentor shadowing.

- Support relationship-driven commercial activities focused on customer service, communication, and problem solving.

- Learn scrap metal identification, quality control, inventory practices, and facility operations from a commercial perspective.

- Review commercial or operational data and recommend improvements to safety, productivity, cost, or customer service.

- Complete a summer-long business project and present recommendations to division leadership.

- Build effective working relationships across commercial, operations, transportation, logistics, and leadership teams.

- Expect to travel frequently.

- You will work outside in extreme weather conditions in an industrial environment.

- Be willing to relocate post-graduation.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

- Rising junior or senior working toward a bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Sales, Economics, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field.

- Strong organization, adaptability, team-orientation, and collaboration skills.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to build relationships, collaborate, and work efficiently with team members.

- Be relationship-driven and customer service focused.

- Ability to make decisions with confidence and demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset.

- Ability to creatively solve problems.

Preferred:

- Previous internship experience.

- Previous leadership experience.

- Previous sales and/or customer service experience.

Pay, Benefits & Career Growth

- Competitive hourly pay.

- Relocation assistance if applicable.

- Exposure to career opportunities in scrap metal recycling after graduation.

- Nucor supports teammates with benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability Insurance, 401(k) and Roth accounts, profit sharing, pay-for-performance bonuses, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement, stock program, scholarships, and more.

Our Commitment to a Drug Free Workplace:

Employment is contingent upon successfully passing a pre-employment drug screening, which includes both urine and hair follicle testing.

Nucor is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – M/F/Disabled/Vets – and a drug – free workplace

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager - Northern California
jobs.description:
Job Details

Division: Rytec Corporation

Location: Jackson, WI, United States

Other Available Locations: N/A

Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.

Nucor supports its teammates with top-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay-for-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.

Basic Job Functions:

SUMMARY:

The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth, profitability, market share, and brand visibility for Rytec within the high-speed door industry. This role focuses on developing and maintaining strong relationships with dealers, end users, and key industry stakeholders while expanding market presence throughout the assigned territory of Northern California. The ideal candidate will possess a proven record in outside industrial sales with direct experience selling high-speed doors. Success in this position requires strong industry knowledge, technical aptitude, relationship-building skills, and the ability to independently manage a large geographic territory. Candidates must reside within the assigned region of Northern California.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

- Identify and pursue new business opportunities that align with Rytec’s value proposition while strengthening existing dealer and customer relationships.

- Develop and execute strategic lead generation initiatives to drive sustained sales growth.

- Present and sell Rytec products and services to dealers, distributors, and end users to achieve territory and company objectives.

- Create and implement territory action plans, including target account development and customer engagement strategies.

- Collaborate with internal teams to maximize lead conversion and sales close rates.

- Follow up on leads, referrals, and customer inquiries generated through field activities and marketing initiatives.

- Prepare and deliver professional presentations, proposals, quotations, and sales agreements.

- Maintain accurate and timely customer and pipeline information within CRM systems.

- Guide customers and internal stakeholders through the sales process to successfully close business opportunities.

- Deliver exceptional customer service by proactively addressing dealer and end-user concerns.

- Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities and strategic advantages.

- Prepare regular reports including sales activity, pipeline status, forecasts, and market intelligence.

- Communicate customer feedback, competitive insights, and market opportunities to internal teams.

- Partner with Marketing to enhance brand awareness and generate product demand throughout the territory.

- Attend and participate in sales meetings, trade shows, product seminars, and industry events.

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

Minimum Qualifications:

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:

- Minimum of 2 years of outside industrial sales experience required.

- Direct experience selling high-speed doors is required. Candidates without experience in high-speed door sales will not be considered.

- Experience in material handling, loading dock equipment, or related industrial markets strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated success in developing and maintaining strong relationships with dealers, distributors, end users, and key stakeholders.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging across diverse audiences and business environments.

- High mechanical aptitude with the ability to understand and communicate technical product information effectively.

- Strong presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage a territory with a high degree of autonomy.

- Proficient in CRM systems and sales pipeline management.

- Ability to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory (approximately 75% of domestic travel required).

- Valid driver’s license and proof of automobile liability and property damage insurance required.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

- This position operates primarily in a professional office and field sales environment.

- Frequent domestic travel (approximately 75%) is required and may include travel by automobile and air transportation.

- Ability to visit industrial facilities, distribution centers, and construction or manufacturing environments as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university preferred; equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.

- Three to ten years of related sales experience in industrial products or systems preferred.

Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace

jobs.title: District Sales Manager - Mississippi Territory
jobs.description:
Job Details

Division: Nucor Building Systems Texas

Location: Flowood, MS, United States

Other Available Locations: Mississippi; Tennessee

The District Sales Manager (DSM) is the primary customer-facing teammate responsible for executing Nucor's goals within the assigned territory to maximize profitability. DSMs manage a defined sales territory by building strong relationships with customers, understanding their needs, and consistently communicating value. This is accomplished through collaboration with Sales, Production and Technical personnel and the customer. Additionally, prospecting customers to grow new business within the assigned territory.
Basic Job Functions:

Responsibilities of the DSM include but are not limited to:

- Establishing and maintaining customer relationships

- Collaborate with customers and builders to interpret construction drawings, product specifications, and   clarify project scope requirements.

- Develop proposals and pricing strategies to close new business

- Applies market knowledge to anticipate customer needs and industry trends

- Maintaining alignment with sales goals and metrics

- Proactively plan and manage own schedule

This position requires extensive overnight travel on a weekly basis as well as a willingness to relocate to sales territory to take care of Nucor customers. This position requires a valid driver's license.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US (Nucor Buildings Group Texas will not sponsor the need for a visa now or in the future).

Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times.

Minimum Qualifications:

- High school diploma or GED.

- Must live in, or be willing to relocate to, the assigned territory.

- 3-5 years of territory sales experience with the ability to manage customer relationships.

- 3–5 years of construction‑industry experience (pre-engineered metal buildings /engineered building products or related fields)

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or Construction desirable.

- Knowledge of pre-engineered metal buildings.

- Consultative / technical sales experience.

About Us

Nucor Buildings Group (NBG), a proud Nucor product group, is one of North America’s largest and most experienced manufacturers of metal building systems. With multiple locations throughout the United States, NBG is proud to design world-class building solutions tailored to meet the needs of any market including commercial, industrial, agricultural, and institutional. Our brands include American Buildings, CBC Steel Buildings, Kirby Building Systems, and Nucor Building Systems. NBG offers work/life balance and a variety of benefits and performance incentives. We take pride in connecting teammates to meaningful work and focus heavily on both personal and professional development. Whether your background is in engineering and design, information technology and software development, marketing, or sales, with Nucor Buildings Group you can go as far as your drive and ambition will take you.

Why Nucor?

When you join Nucor, America’s largest steel manufacturer and recycler, you’ll help create a variety of steel products that become so much more, for so many people. And you won’t do it alone. Our supportive culture builds each other up, values family, relationships, and puts safety above anything else. With the freedom to take your ideas to the next level, there’s no end to what you can achieve. This is your chance to build a lifelong career, give back to your community, make the world a better place – and BE PART OF SOMETHING BIGGER .

Job Security – Benefits – Bonus Programs

With performance-based compensation, profit sharing, and a no-layoff practice, we take care of our teammates who design, engineer, fabricate, and support the products that define our company.

Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace

Basic Job Functions:

Nucor Steel Sedalia seeks a qualified candidate for the HR Manager position to lead all Human Resources functions for the Division.  This position leads both people and the HR function at the location, maintaining a visible leadership presence while balancing structure and consistent processes with openness and approachability.   Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Benefits: Oversees benefits (medical, dental, vision, eye care, flexible spending accounts, life, disability, 401K retirement savings plan, EAP, wellness initiatives, FMLA, ADA, Furlough, and HIPAA administration

- Compensation/Payroll:  Oversees weekly payroll administration and attendance tracking

- Employee Relations: Handles division-wide communication, responds to teammate and manager concerns, assists with investigations, provides counsel/guidance regarding policies/procedures, and organizes company functions.

- Recruiting/Employment:  Oversees recruiting of full-time teammates, student employment programs, & terminations in accordance with legal/regulatory requirements.

- Training/Development:  Oversees division-wide training activities and assists with teammate development

- Public/Community Relations: Oversees community support activities and advertising

- Participates in developing/implementing strategic plans to meet objectives

The successful candidate will uphold Nucor’s values such as integrity, work ethic, and personal responsibility. Safety is the most important part of all jobs withing Nucor; therefore candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practicers, procedures & housekeeping standards at all times to ensure our team is 100% safe.

Minimum Requirements:

- Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources or Related Field

- 3 Years Leadership Experience Directly leading and Developing People/Teams

- 5 Years Human Resources Experience

- No Relatives employed with Nucor Steel Sedalia

Detailed Selection Criteria:

- HR Acumen: Knowledge of HR principles, procedures, and practices – recruitment, selection, training, compensation and benefits, employment law, and personnel system – applied with business judgement to support location strategy.

- Developing and Building Teams : Demonstrated history of working as part of a team,  building trust and credibility by acting with integrity and consistency, fostering mutual respect and cooperation among team members, and using interpersonal influence to align others around shared goals.

- Communication Skills: The ability to give full attention to what others are saying and communicate information so others understand.

- Leadership Presence and Courage:  Willingness and confidence to have immediate and direct conversations on critical alignment issues across all levels of the organization, including with senior leaders, such as teamwork, building relationships, initiating and supporting change, and other HR issues that arise.  This includes the courage to challenge thinking and face adversity and conflict head-on.

- Initiative: Monitoring/assessing performance of self, independently and proactively seeking out work that needs to be done and fully committing to fulfilling obligations, and willingly to take on responsibilities and challenges.

- Coaching/Developing Others: Identifying strengths & developmental needs of others to include coaching, mentoring, teaching, training, and helping others to improve their skills to work effectively

- Problem Solving & Judgement/Decision Making: Identifying problems, gathering relevant information, and weighing options to make informed decisions, take effective action, and lead others in mitigating risk.

- Training and Development: Identify the training needs of the division and effectively develop and implement training and processes to help others improve their knowledge and skills to work safely and effectively.  This includes continually evaluating progress.

Preferences:

- Human Resources experience working in a manufacturing environment

- Knowledge of federal and state employment laws and regulations

- SAP/Success Factors software experience

- Workforce Solutions timekeeping experience

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Nucor will not sponsor the need for a visa now or in the future.

Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace.
